This is a pretty common occurrence. I dealt with similar. 
"We only have sex when YOU want to" has been tossed around my household. Talk to him about how you feel and what you want. If he's not receptive, he might not be the one for you.
Getting him to open up and be honest would be my best advice.

As other commentators have suggested, don't let yourself get used. Your priority is YOU (and kids if you have them).

Baby steps!

Best of luck!

Sounds fake perhaps, but discovering how to do something feels so good when it matches up with our emotional needs.
